documents.title: Amendment to the Seventh Schedule under section 3 of Telangana Motor Vehicles Taxation Act, 1963 (Act No.5 of 1963) - Notification
documents.issuing_authority: Transport, Roads & Buildings (Tr.I) Department, Government of Telangana
documents.notes: Department G.O. copy dated 20-03-2026, from the GOIR register. Amends the Seventh Schedule as amended by G.O.Ms.No. 22/2022 and 53/2025 (removes the additional 2% tax on second or more personalised vehicles). The text states it comes into force with effect from 23-03-2026; effective_date left null pending legal review. Gazette print not obtained. Title, number, department and date were read from the document (09-11-2026); this is not legal verification. Scope checked against the PDF (09-11-2026): deletes column No. 8 of the Seventh Schedule and its entries (additional 2% on second or more personalized vehicles up to 10 seats owned by an individual, at registration of new vehicles only). Para 4: in force with effect from 23-03-2026.
